content: Keliso Tuwana I Powonan Pamaisena ge Sauga Gegewena kaiwena

Mosese wana Logugui iya waisi toto abwe i nenem kakanununa ya, he iya nige waisi toto tutunahotina hot i oola, yaa waisi tutunahotina Logugui enaa abwe i gan. Inoke Logugui nige bosowaina gamagalau bolo hi nem ge hi tapwalolo ni abubunil ge nihi sapu, bwagana baliman maisena ge maisena wali powon ona hi ginol papasikali.

Binimala ebo Logugui totapwalolo ni pasapol, he powon ana awaawaginol nihi paveyaho. Nihi paveyaho, kaiwena pamaisena wali gegi iyaka ni mowasi hot ge nihi yanayana, inoke ateliyaa nige al nihi nunuwatu tage heliya togegi.
Yaa baliman maisena ge maisena powon bolo hi giginol o i papanuwahikagil te heliya togegi.
Kaiwena bulumakau melutauil ge goti saliyaliya nige bosowaina gamagalau wali gegi ni ahek yoho.
Inoke heiya te kaiwena Keliso kamwasa getoga i pwela. Wana sauga nem panayawiya i baek Yehoba elana i ba:

content.text: Bwasumu powopowonina nige nuwam i oola,
yaa tuwau u lovivina-an u pem ge na patuwalali kaiwem.
Powon hi ton olan ge gegi powonina nige u yayaliyaya-an.
Yaka abwe ya ba, “O Yehoba, nau hiwe, ya nem ge wam nuwatu na ginol,
ni ola to kaiweu hi lelelian Buki Bwabwalena gamwanaa.”

content: Leleli toto o gamwanaa, houwan i ba, “Bwasumu powopowonina, powon hi ton olan, ge gegi powonina nige nuwam i oola, nige u yayaliyaya-an.” (He Logugui te i ba powon bolo ona o gamagalau nihi ginolil.)
Yaka abwe i ba, “Nau hiwe, ya nem ge wam nuwatu na ginol.” Inoke eliyana kamwasa toto houwan iyaka i ahek yoho ge kamwasa labuina iyaka i pamilil.
He Yeisu Keliso i nem ge Yehoba wana nuwatu i ginol, yaka tuwana i powonan pamaisena ge sauga gegewena kaiwena, inoke eliyana i abubunila ge i pwabwabwalena-agila.
Lan gegewena topowon hi talmilil tapwalolo ana tuwalali hi awaawaginol ge powon ona hi powonan papasikali, yaa powon o nige bosowaina gegi ni ahek yoho.
Yaa Keliso powon maisena ya i ginol gamagalau wali gegi kaiwena, ge powon o ana gasisi i gan sauga gegewena nige ni momowasi. Yaka abwe i misiyowa Yehoba labena awonaa,
ge sauga ya iya iyoho i matamatan ana siga ana topihigelgel Yehoba ni teli lowagil aena gabulanaa.
He powon maisena ya i ginol, inoke kilau bolo i pwabwabwalena-agila ta tabwa Yehoba wana gamagalau iyaka i abubunila ge ta sapu Yehoba matanaa sauga gegewena nige ni momowasi.
Buki Bwabwalena gamwanaa Yayaluwa Bwabwalena al ge i wasa eliyala nuwatu ya kaiwena. He houwan ga i wasa i ola hiwe:

content.text: Babala i ba, “Bateli toto sauga mulaa abwe na ginol kaiweliya ni ola hiwe.
No logugui na teliya ateliyaa ge nihi atena,
ge na leliya wali nuwatu elana ge nihi henapuan.”

content: Yaka i wasa vevehe al i ba, “Wali gegi ge wali ginol nanakina nige al na nunuwahikan.”
He Yehoba wala gegi ge wala ginol nanakina iyaka i ahek yoho nige al i nunuwahikan, inoke nige al gegi powonina ginolina ni gagan.
Palahikan ana Ba Pagasisi
Taliwau ge nuwau, Yeisu saliyana eliyana bosowaina alola wala atimatuwa ta ulutuk Aban Bwabwalena Hot elana ta na Yehoba manininaa.

Yeisu abaulutuk ana kamwasa vavaluna iyaka i pwela kaiwela, iya yawal ana kamwasa, inoke baba tomwa ana kaliko toto hi pakuki Aban Bwabwalena Hot ana abaulutuk hi kausiya sauga ya i mwapwela. He i mwapwelaa te Yeisu tuwana eliyana ge i yaomal kaiwela.
Ge wala topowon bwabwatana i gan iya Yehoba wana boda i matahikagil.

He kamwasa i mwapwela ge wala topowon bwabwatana i gan, inoke kakawi nuwatuina ta ahek yoho atelaa ge wala abulilek ni matuwa ge ta nok ta na Yehoba elana. Ta nok elana kaiwena atela iyaka i abubun wala gegi bikena i mowasi, ge tuwala iyaka i ul wewel waiwaisana elana.

Ge iyaka ta abulilek te bwaliga Yehoba waisi ni pem yaka ta wasawasa-an i ola to. He abulilek o ta pihikan momol ge bahi ta nunuwa lalabui, kaiwena bosowaina Yehoba ana mel ta teli ni ginol ni ola wana bateli.
Ge avalau kaiweliya ta nuwanuwatu inoke ta ba pagasisi-agil nihi nunuwana ge pagan waiwaisana nihi ginol.
He bahi mimigogo paganina ta papaveyaho ni oola bolo enuna hi giginol, yaa ta peba pagapagasisi-agila. Wala ginol ni olaola ya to, kaiwena Babala wana lan sikalim i kelaubwa.
Ebo wasa tutunahotina iyaka ta atena haba, ge abwe ta nuwatu ta ba, “Gegi paganina na awaawaginol ya,” he nige powon etega al i gagan ge tage wala gegi ni yakil yoho.
Nasi alola ge wala lovakun ta matamatan ya te Yehoba ni payatalala ge ni telela ginaha kalakalasina hot elana, toto Yehoba ana topihigelgel ni tonil.
Ebo gamagal etega Mosese wana Logugui ni awatautau-an, ge topekiti ali toto eluwa o ebo eton wana gegi nihi wasaan, he ana lahi iyai te nihi tagapaaliga, nige nihi aatilomwan-an.

Yaa ebo gamagal etega Yeisu ni teli lowan ni ba, “Iya nige Yehoba Natuna i oola,” ku nuwatu ana lahi ga ni ola? Ge ebo saliya toto bateli vavaluna i patunahot ge wana gegi iyaka i ul yoho, ni awa kekeisisi-an ni ba, “Saliyana nige bugul hot i oola, amwahika te i yaomal,” ana lahi ga ni ola? Ge ebo gamagal o Yayaluwa Bwabwalena Tomumulolu ni ba panapanak-an ni ba, “Nige wana gasisi eliyana i oola ge Yeisu ginol yawiyawi i ginolil,” ana lahi ga ni ola? He iya ana lahi ni bwata hot, gamagal toto Mosese wana Logugui i awatautau-an nige ana lahi i bwabwata.
Ta atena te Yehoba i ba, “Nau abwe na ginol lahe eliyalil, wali nak molana na ginol lahe.” Ge i ba al i ba, “Babala wana gamagalau ni pakotil.”
He abalovakun hot te ebo Yabowaine yawalina gaganina ni kukuhikagila lahi kaiwena.
Ku nuwatu ga sauga valila toto abwe Wasa Waiwaisana mwananalina i yanemiu. Pulowan hi gewi hi anlowagimiu ge lomwanina ku pwawa, yaa ku palahikan ge ku talmilil gagasisi.

Sauga enuna hi patalmilil-agimiu boda mataliyaa yaka hi ba panapanak-agimiu ge hi ginol panak eliyamiu. Ge i ola al sauga enuna ku palabi alomiyau eliyalil bolo ali hehegan hi apapanak-an i ola to, ge ku label.

Sauga ebo alomiyau enuna hi telel dela, inoke atemiu i lomwanagil ge ali labe ku ginol. Sauga tologugui wami bugubugul hi bugulan bwabwage, he ku yaliyaya ya, kaiwena ku atena te gogomwau hot iyoho eliyamiu, toto mihomihotina.
Inoke wami atimatuwa toto valila ni gasisi, kaiwena ebo nuku ola, abwe mola bwabwatana nuku ahe.
Nuku palahikan ga, inoke hauna toto Yehoba i bateli kaiwemiu nuku ahe, kaiwena wana nuwatu ku ginol.
Kaiwena

content.text: sauga kekeisi hot te toto i nenem ni vin, nige ni eesowal.
Yaa no gamagalau bolo hi sapu, yawaliliya ni gan kaiwena hi abulilek,
ge ebo etega ni sikalek enaa, nige na yayaliyaya kaiwena.

content: He kila nige gamagalau bolo hi sikalek eliyaa ge hi yaomal i oola, yaa kila gamagalau bolo ta abulilek ge yawal ta pwawa.
